summary: Fort Lauderdale Hollywood International Airport (FLL) is a major South Florida gateway located about three miles southwest of downtown Fort Lauderdale, serving the broader Miami metropolitan area. Originally developed from a World War II-era naval air station, it has grown into one of the busiest airports in the United States, known as a key hub for low-cost and ultra-low-cost carriers, particularly Spirit Airlines. With four terminals and a wide mix of domestic and international service, FLL offers a popular alternative to the busier Miami International Airport just to the south.
faqs:
Q: How far is Fort Lauderdale Hollywood International Airport from downtown Fort Lauderdale?
A: The airport is approximately 3 miles (5 km) southwest of downtown Fort Lauderdale, typically a 10–15 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: Does FLL offer international flights?
A: Yes, FLL has a dedicated International Terminal (Terminal 4) handling flights to and from destinations in Canada, the Caribbean, Latin America, and Europe.

Q: Are there public transportation options to FLL?
A: Yes, the Tri-Rail commuter train has a station adjacent to the airport, and Broward County Transit buses also serve the terminals.

Q: Is FLL a hub for any airline?
A: Spirit Airlines operates one of its largest hubs at FLL, offering numerous domestic and international routes.
transport_tips: The airport is directly accessible via Interstate 595 and Interstate 95, making it convenient for travelers driving in from Miami, West Palm Beach, or the Florida Keys. Tri-Rail provides affordable service connecting FLL to Miami, West Palm Beach, and other South Florida cities, with the station located just a short walk or shuttle ride from the terminals. Ride-share services and taxis are readily available curbside at each terminal, and many hotels in the area offer complimentary shuttle pickups.
local_tip: If you're heading to Port Everglades to catch a cruise, FLL is one of the closest major airports to the terminals—many cruise lines run shuttle services directly from the airport, making it a smoother option than flying into Miami.
